workspaceExportNativeDescription: A complete Leafen backup for moving or restoring this workspace. This format preserves Leafen structure and metadata.
workspaceExportOmittedPages_one: {{count}} database page shared with you on its own is excluded, since the archive restores databases as a whole. The Markdown & CSV and HTML bundles include it.
workspaceExportOmittedPages_other: {{count}} database pages shared with you on their own are excluded, since the archive restores databases as a whole. The Markdown & CSV and HTML bundles include them.
workspaceExportOmittedFiles_one: {{count}} file was still arriving or had been removed, so it is left out. Export again to include what has arrived since.
workspaceExportOmittedFiles_other: {{count}} files were still arriving or had been removed, so they are left out. Export again to include what has arrived since.
workspaceExportReconnecting: The server isn’t responding. The export progress appears here again as soon as it’s back; there’s nothing to do.
logOutNoEmailBody: This account has no email, so getting back in takes another logged-in device or a code from an administrator. You can add an email or a passkey first in Settings → Account.
remoteSignOutUnresolved: You’re logged out on this device, but the server session is still open. Try again or contact your administrator.
pendingSignOutDescription: These changes are stored only on this device. Discarding them cannot be undone.
pendingSignOutReadFailedTitle: Local changes could not be checked
pendingSignOutReadFailedDescription: Some changes may be stored only on this device. Cancel to keep them, or explicitly discard local changes to log out.
outsideAddressCardBody: Turn it on to use Leafen from phones, other devices, or the Claude and ChatGPT apps.
agentCardBody: Let Claude Code or Codex use Leafen as its memory.
noRecents: Your recently opened pages show up here.
noSectionsToAdd: Every section is on the sidebar
shortcutsFull: A tab holds up to {{limit}} shortcuts. Remove one you no longer use to add another.
viewsFull: A tab holds up to {{limit}} database views. Remove one you no longer use to add another.
layoutTooLarge: The sidebar setup is too large to save (32 KB). Remove shortcuts or tabs you no longer use.

profiles.addTitle: Add an account on another server
profiles.addDescription: Enter the Leafen server’s address, then log in on that server.
profiles.invalidAddress: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
profiles.notLeafen: No Leafen server answered at that address
profiles.plainAddressRefused: Here Leafen connects only to a secure address (https://). Enter the server’s https address, or scan the QR code or open the invite link its screen shows.

addWindow.chooseFeatures: Select features to turn on or off
addWindow.createFailed: The database wasn’t created. Please try again.

membershipAskTitle: Try Leafen as a workspace member
membershipAskCreate: <muted>Projects, notes, to-dos, and more</muted>: create and organize them.
membershipAskPages: <muted>Access every page in the workspace</muted> to see what’s new.
membershipAskFeatures: <muted>All of Leafen’s features</muted> to get more done.

connect.title: Let {{host}} show your workspaces?
connect.body: Leafen pages at {{host}} will list {{account}}’s workspaces and apps on this server in their switcher — their names and icons, whether you’re a guest and whether anything is unread. They can’t read or change pages. You can revoke this in Settings → Server accounts.

openLink.title: Open {{host}}?
openLink.body: This link opens a Leafen server this app hasn’t used yet. Open it only if you trust where the link came from; you’ll log in there.

manualOrderConfirmDetail: The manual order you set before in {{section}} goes away.
